description: This line plot compares the loss values of two models, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” as a function of computational cost measured in TFLOPs. The x-axis represents TFLOPs, scaled logarithmically, ranging from 0.00 to 1.25e9, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.25 (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00, 1.25). The y-axis represents Loss, scaled linearly, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. The “Vanilla” model is depicted by a purple line with triangle markers and a dashed line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0.00 TFLOPs and decreasing to about 2.50 at 1.25e9 TFLOPs. The “SepLLM” model is shown by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0.00 TFLOPs and decreasing to about 2.46 at 1.25e9 TFLOPs. A green dashed horizontal line marks the 2.50 loss level, and a green dashed vertical box highlights the region from 1.00 to 1.25e9 TFLOPs, with an annotation indicating a 1.28x increase in TFLOPs for that segment. Both lines show a consistent downward trend in loss as TFLOPs increase.
